name: Protecting The Church
overview: Scripture reveals that the Church is founded on the person of Christ, the solid rock upon which it is built, and that it is divinely protected so that the gates of hell will not prevail against it. Believers are not removed from the world but are kept from evil through God's care. Church leaders are entrusted by the Holy Spirit to diligently oversee and feed the Church, which Christ Himself purchased with His own blood, emphasizing both the sacred responsibility and the divine protection involved in safeguarding the Church.
